name: side-panel
description: A side pane next to the Claude Code chat, opened with /panel: every project's STATUS.md as a card (what waits for you, what is broken, the next step), your plan, ideas and the projects with no STATUS.md, plus a PC-now tab with sessions, tokens, GPU and render jobs.
